Global Metadata
Genre & Subgenres: East Asian Pop (Guofeng)
Tempo: Moderate tempo, 60–70 BPM, 4/4 time signature, featuring gentle taiko rhythm and lyrical phrasing.
Emotional Progression: Opens with nostalgic yearning, transitions through serene reflection, escalates emotionally during the bridge’s poetic revelation, culminates in uplifting resolution as nature's harmony embraces human resilience.
Sonic & Production Profile: Layered instrumentation combining erhu melodies, pipa arpeggios, guzheng drones, dizi flutes, and light orchestration; spatial reverb creates immersive landscape ambiance while vocals sit centrally balanced with clarity and warmth.

Vocal Details
Lead Configuration: Female lead vocalist, mezzo-soprano range.
Timbre & Delivery: Warm, emotive soprano tones conveying both fragility and strength; softly delivered verses evolve into passionate, expansive choruses.
Harmony & Backing Vocals: Gentle layered harmonies throughout verses build density before dissolving into airy pads in choruses; no adlibs except minimal breathy echoes.
Vocal Effects: Natural tonality emphasized; slight reverberation enhances distance effect without overpowering intimacy.

Arrangement
[Intro]: Solo dizi introduces theme atop slow-moving guzheng tremolo underpinning muted taiko beats — evokes mist-shrouded mountainscape.
[Verse 1]: Erhu carries main motif against delicate guzheng pizzicato patterns; occasional bamboo flute interjections add color; lyrics focus on solitary wanderer recalling past glory beneath autumn leaves.
[Pre-Chorus 1]: Strings rise gently behind ascending melodic fragments played by pipa; percussive accents introduce urgency;
vocals gain intensity matching rising cadence.
[Chorus 1]: Full ensemble swells—dizi leads melody supported by rich strings and brass bursts; vocal group unifies call-and-response style emphasizing communal memory.
[Verse 2]: Return to minimalist textures using only guzheng and dizi motifs interspersed with whispered recitative-like narration.
[Pre-Chorus 2]: Harmonized vocal layerings deepen emotion as instrumental palette expands again via harp glissandi and gong resonance.
[Chorus 2]: Repetition intensifies dynamics—with fuller horn arrangements and syncopated rhythms enhancing grandeur.
[Bridge]: Sudden transition into pure instrumental passage (solo erhu accompanied by shimmering celesta); then returns abruptly to voice singing poignant refrain amid swirling winds simulated by wind machines and reversed tape effects.
[Final Chorus]: Grand culmination blending all prior themes: orchestra reaches maximum volume paired with female chorus delivering triumphant declaration about enduring beauty despite hardship.
[Outro]: Gradual fade-out begins with single note held by guzheng followed by faint dizi sigh—a lingering whisper symbolizing peace restored after turmoil.

## MiniMax Music 3

A music generation model by MiniMax that creates complete songs up to 5 minutes long with stable structure and high audio quality. Two inputs drive it: **Caption** (structured music description: style, mood, vocals, arrangement) and **Lyrics** (with `[intro]` `[verse]` `[chorus]` `[bridge]` `[outro]` tags controlling song structure).

### Parameters

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| Caption | Music description. Write it in three sections — Global Metadata → Vocal Details → Arrangement. The more specific, the closer the result. |
| Lyrics | Song lyrics + section tags. Tags are the only executable structural instructions; the lyric text itself only conveys mood. |
| max_duration | Target song length in seconds (default 120 = 2 minutes; the model supports up to ~300 s / 5 minutes). Longer songs take more time and VRAM. |
| seed | Random seed for the generation. Keep it fixed to reproduce the same song; change it to get a different take. |
| Model files | diffusion model / text encoder / VAE.|
| Tiled decode | Decode the audio VAE in overlapping tiles to drastically cut VRAM usage — helpful for long songs on low-VRAM GPUs. Slightly slower, with a small risk of seams at tile boundaries; turn it off on high-VRAM GPUs for the best quality. |

### Prompt Writing Guide

You can find an official [Music Caption Rewriter Skill here](https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-Music3)

Global Metadata: A Mandopop / C-pop guofeng ballad in the East Asian ballad & heritage pop family, with Chinese traditional instruments over modern cinematic-pop production; slow, breathing four-four around 68-76 BPM, gentle half-time in the verses and more motion in the choruses. The arc moves from solitary snowbound introspection through gathering urgency, warm resolute devotion, fragile bridge reflection, to a long tender final peak and a still quiet outro. The mix is wide and polished: bright plucked guzheng and breathy dizi above a warm rounded low end, spacious verses, dense gently compressed choruses, a bare bridge, an expansive final chorus, with tasteful reverbs and subtle reverse-swell transitions.

Vocal Details: A single female lead with a clear, crystalline, slightly breathy tone, warm in the low register and glowing on top, vibrato widening on long notes. Delivery is soft and narrative in the verses, builds through the pre-chorus, soars in the chorus with sustained belt, near-whisper in the bridge, and a long held note in the final chorus. Layered self-harmonies in parallel thirds and octaves widen the choruses, and a distant echoing backing voice floats in the outro; effects stay restrained, plate reverb, a subtle dotted delay on phrase tails, light compression.

Arrangement: Built around guzheng, dizi, piano and strings in one continuous arch: intro is solo guzheng over a low piano pedal with wind chimes and a faint pad, no percussion; verse one keeps the guzheng as the harmonic and melodic skeleton with warm piano, subtle bass, and a distant dizi line rising near the end; pre-chorus one builds over a swelling pad with reverse-cymbal swell while the groove settles on kick and finger-cymbals; the chorus arrives in full band - kick-and-snare, hi-hats, deep electric bass, string ensemble, guzheng glissandos, dizi ornaments and layered vocals; verse two recedes to piano arpeggios and muted guzheng over brush drum and string bed; the instrumental carries guzheng and dizi call-and-response over piano and strings with a long drum roll crescendo; the bridge strips to a single guzheng note and whisper-close voice in silence; the final chorus opens widest - upper-octave strings, stacked lines and a long held note - and the outro dissolves on the opening guzheng motif, a breath of dizi, one warm piano chord and fading wind chimes.

[Intro]
（古筝泛音 · 雪落声 · 一盏残灯）

[Verse 1]
雪满长安 一更又一更
灯下研墨 写不完你的名
一句心事 写到心思停
落款处 只落一盏等

[Pre-Chorus]
月过寒窗 不肯分明
隔着千山 谁替我传声

[Chorus]
借一轮月色 照你归程
我点着一盏灯 守着孤城
千里风雪 都是我的回声
雪落一整夜 我醒着在等

[Verse 2]
石桥青苔 又落一层
旧笛悬梁 冻到不肯醒
夜深偏长 灯花结成影
你名字落地 像雪压住长安的声

[Pre-Chorus]
呵出暖雾 窗上画你的名
怕雪停以后 认不出这盏灯

[Chorus]
借一城的月光 引你归程
我用一生 暖你这一盏灯
风雪来回 就作我的歌声
你回来 让雪落得安静

[Instrumental]
（古筝 · 竹笛 对答 · 雪落声）

[Bridge]
那年大雪 封冷了寒冬
我们在两扇窗前 各守一盏灯
若来世再有一盏 等你的灯
我定比雪 更早亮到三更

[Final Chorus]
借一生的月色 唤你归程
你门前的长明 便是我这一盏灯
纵使大雪漫过 千山万城
长安的灯海 都写着你的名

[Outro]
雪停了
灯还亮着
我还在城中
等你回程

# Role
你是一个精通 MiniMax Music3 音乐生成模型的提示词工程师。你的任务是根据用户提供的【歌曲描述】，构建符合要求的【输出提示词】。


# MiniMax Music3 规则知识库
1. **输出格式**：
   - 【输出提示词】为json格式，包含三个字段：name(**歌曲名字 (Song Title)**)、caption(**歌曲简述 (Song Caption)**)、lyrics(**歌词（Lyrics）**)。
   - 【输出提示词】示例如下（必须严格参照此格式）：
       {
           "name":"xxx",
           "caption":"xxx",
           "lyrics":"xxx"
       }

2. **歌曲名字 (Song Title)**：若用户未输入语种相关提示词，则使用中文。
   - 歌曲名字只能是文字或者单词，且限定在10个文字或单词以内。
   - 歌曲名字要根据 **歌词（Lyrics）** 的内容进行凝练。

3. **歌曲简述 (Song Caption)**：用简短的自然语言描述歌曲的风格、音色、乐器、主题、编曲等等，并且必须为英文。
   - 全局描述必须且按顺序包含3部分：**全局元数据(Global Metadata)**、**人声细节(Vocal Details)**、**编曲(Arrangement)**。
     - **全局元数据(Global Metadata)**：根据用户提供的【歌曲描述】生成合适的 **全局元数据(Global Metadata)**，仅提取已支持或可合理推断的参数。
       - 全局元数据包含4部分：**曲风流派与子流派(Genre & Subgenres)**、**音乐节奏(Tempo)**、**情感递进逻辑(Emotional Progression)**，**声音和制作简介(Sonic & Production Profile)**。
       - **音乐节奏(Tempo)**的要求：仅在用户明确指定或有充分理由时使用精确BPM，否则使用速度范围或定性描述；仅在用户明确指定或对音乐生成有实际帮助时，标注调号与音阶。
       - **曲风流派与子流派(Genre & Subgenres)**：
         - 曲风流派分类(最终曲风流派，只能从以下曲风流派中选择，下面的曲风流派是按照 [曲风标签: 包含的曲风流派类别] 这样的格式列出的，其中曲风标签不可作为歌曲的曲风流派使用，只有它包含的曲风流派类别可以作为歌曲的曲风流派使用)：
           - east-asian-modern 类的曲风包括: Mandopop, C-pop, Cantopop, J-pop with electronic, R&B, hip-hop, dance, funk, rock, or metal production
           - east-asian-ballad-heritage 类的曲风包括: Mandopop, C-pop, Cantopop, J-pop ballad, guofeng pop, acoustic or orchestral East Asian pop
           - modern-rnb-neo-soul 类的曲风包括: Contemporary R&B, alternative R&B, neo-soul, trap soul, atmospheric R&B
           - soul-blues-gospel 类的曲风包括: Soul, blues, blues rock, gospel, worship, soul-blues
           - cinematic-pop-ballad 类的曲风包括: Cinematic pop, cinematic ballad, orchestral pop song, soundtrack-like vocal ballad
           - cinematic-orchestral-epic 类的曲风包括: Film score, orchestral, trailer, epic choral, symphonic soundtrack, contemporary classical
           - lectronic-synth-ambient-pop 类的曲风包括: ynth-pop, electropop, dream pop, ambient pop, darkwave, retrowave, downtempo
           - jazz-swing-big-band 类的曲风包括: Vocal jazz, jazz ballad, big band, swing, bossa nova, lounge jazz
           - traditional-vocal-stage 类的曲风包括: Traditional pop, crooner, doo-wop, a cappella, musical theatre, show tune, cabaret
           - hip-hop-rap 类的曲风包括: Hip-hop, rap, trap, drill, lo-fi hip-hop, conscious rap, melodic rap
           - metal-heavy-rock 类的曲风包括: Metalcore, power metal, symphonic metal, nu-metal, hard rock, post-hardcore
           - pop-alternative-rock 类的曲风包括: Pop rock, alternative rock, indie rock, arena rock, J-rock, punk, post-grunge
           - contemporary-folk-acoustic 类的曲风包括: Indie folk, contemporary folk, folk pop, singer-songwriter, modern acoustic pop

           - general-pop-ballad 类的曲风包括: Pop, contemporary pop, pop ballad, broadly described emotional song
